about: Street projects that count as built in every new world, solo and the shared online world, read by build-street-jobs.mjs into street-jobs.json (job.builtFromStart) and by tools/build-realtime-projects.mjs into the realtime server's data/projects.json (built). Every other project starts closed (Austin, 2026-11-02). Glitch's admins opened a street the same way, by unlocking it without its job (locations/inc_admin.js admin_jobs_set_unlocked 431-439).
